QF.id: III-C Prevention of Money Laundering Act_5

question.text: The officer who may order provisional attachment under Section 5 of PMLA shall not be below the rank of:

answer.text: Deputy Director, authorized by the Director

explanation.text: The Logic: Source p.160 states that under Section 5 of PMLA, the Director or any other officer not below the rank of Deputy Director, authorized by the Director, may order provisional attachment. The Trap: Higher-ranking officers may seem more appropriate, but the source-specified minimum rank is Deputy Director, when authorized by the Director. Note: Authorization by the Director is part of the test, not just the officer's rank.
